help.sourceOfTruth: Master tables are the source of truth for finite choices shown throughout the application. Deactivating an entry keeps historical references while preventing new selection.
help.customBody: Finite select fields expose an explicit Custom option. Custom values remain visible and editable; the application does not silently coerce them to a nearby code.
help.panelsBody: A panel is the set of antibiotics tested for an organism and specimen combination. Pick organisms and specimens from their catalogues; leaving specimens empty matches every specimen for those organisms.
help.panelsRequirement: Each antibiotic carries a requirement type. Essential members (always tested, or one of an option group) are pre-loaded on the isolate entry screen. Optional members — conditional, surrogate or synergy agents — are offered there as add-ons the centre can add per isolate.
help.dependenciesBody: Panels reference antibiotics, organisms, specimens, locations and domains. Deletion can therefore be blocked, while deactivation is usually safer for catalogue maintenance.
